nodes.title: Acceptance probability of the BLR test

nodes.summary: Let $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \{-1, 1\}$ (a function $\mathbb{F}_2^n \to \mathbb{F}_2$ in the $\pm 1$ encoding) and $\varepsilon \in \mathbb{R}$. If the BLR test accepts $f$ with probability at least $1 - \varepsilon$, then $f$ is $\varepsilon$-close to a linear function: there is $S$ with $\mathrm{dist}(f, \chi_S) \le \varepsilon$.
nodes.title: Blum–Luby–Rubinfeld linearity test

nodes.summary: For $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \{-1, 1\}$ and every $S$, $\mathrm{dist}(f, \chi_S) = \tfrac12 - \tfrac12 \hat f(S)$: the Fourier coefficient $\hat f(S) = \langle f, \chi_S\rangle$ measures the correlation of $f$ with the linear function $\chi_S$.
nodes.title: Distance to a character

nodes.summary: For $f, g : \{-1, 1\}^n \to \mathbb{R}$, the relative Hamming distance is $\mathrm{dist}(f, g) = \Pr_x[f(x) \ne g(x)]$ for uniform $x$; $f$ is $\varepsilon$-close to $g$ when $\mathrm{dist}(f, g) \le \varepsilon$.
nodes.title: Relative Hamming distance on the Boolean cube

nodes.summary: Every character $\chi_S(x) = \prod_{i \in S} x_i$ takes only the values $1$ and $-1$ on $\{-1, 1\}^n$, since $\chi_S(x)^2 = 1$. The characters are the Boolean-valued linear functions of the BLR test.
nodes.title: Characters are $\pm 1$-valued

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
